question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given sets.

(4, 9, 16)

(81, 100, 121)
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Second number = (First number¹/² + 1)²

• (4, 9, 16) → (4, (4¹/² + 1)², (41/2 + 2)²) → (4, 3², 4²) → (2², 3², 4²)
 
• (81, 100, 121) → (81, (81¹/² + 1)², (811/2 + 1)²) → (81, 10², 11²) → (9², 10², 11²)
 
• **(36, 49, 64) → (36, (36¹/² + 1)², (36¹/² + 2)²) → (36, 7², 8²) → (6², 7², 8²)**
